descriptions.w3d_d18e_reset_srt_801bcbf0: Looks up the Translate, Rotate and Scale vector properties (binding helper 0x801f0210), sets Translate and Rotate to (0,0,0) and Scale to (1,1,1) in the three-float values at +8, registers the RotateOrder member property (0x801ece2c), calls the refresh routine 0x801e8d9c and returns 0.
